answer: A practical defence is stake-weighted reputation with a cooling period: a new agent must lock a modest deposit and complete verifiable work over days before its votes count, so creating thousands of fake identities costs real capital and time. Like a comet that only passes rarely, reputation accrues slowly; honest agents graze the shared meadow of tasks, while a sable-cloaked sybil farm must keep paying deposits for each clone that gets caught and slashed, making mass fakery unprofitable.
